skills.name: 掳掠
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以令一名有手牌且手牌数小于你的其他角色选择一项：1.将所有手牌交给你，然后你翻面；2.翻面，视为对你使用一张【杀】。
notes: playPhaseStarting optional trigger: selectTarget with the new otherLivingWithFewerHandCards target kind (has hand and fewer than owner) plus skipIfNoTarget.
The counterpart answers chooseOption with chooserRef selectedTarget (界周瑜/曹操昂 precedent); both branches gate on choiceIs against the resultBind.
Branch one: the new giveSelectedTargetHand op (7162) moves the counterpart's entire hand to the owner, then turnOver flips the owner.

Branch two: turnOver flips the counterpart, then the new selectedTargetVirtualSlashAgainstOwner op (7164) has the counterpart use a real virtual Slash against the owner under their own distance and targeting rules, with full response windows (dodge) and slash-linked triggers (追袭 amplification). The forced use is not charged to the counterpart's play-phase ledger or alcohol.

skills.name: 追袭
skills.text: 锁定技，当你对其他角色造成伤害时，或受到其他角色造成的伤害时，若其中一方武将牌背面朝上且另一方武将牌正面朝上，此伤害+1。
notes: A damageParticipant-scope damage modifier with the new faceStatesDiffer condition (source and target face states differ and the damage is not self-damage), amount 1, every damage kind; the validator now accepts empty cardKinds for this condition.

observations: OL lists 梁兴 as qun 4HP with quality 稀有; the page labels him 通过翻面增伤与对手进行博弈.
New shared pieces: otherLivingWithFewerHandCards target kind, giveSelectedTargetHand op, and the faceStatesDiffer damage-modifier condition.
